author: htdarwiche
quote:
What happened with this release erases 25+ years of hard work by great developers and writers who made GTA what it is!

A game called Grand Theft Auto where you can't even steal any car you want?
A crime game where you can't kill protesters or certain groups of people?
A criminal who can't cheat on his girlfriend?

The game that made hookers an iconic part of its world doesn't even have hookers anymore?

Six hours into the game, and I'm playing House Flipper???

Was this game made by a bunch of 10-year-old emo girls or what? I'm genuinely confused. I can't believe what happened to this franchise.

I wish I'd donated my $99 to an elderly care home instead.
